name: Microsoft Outlook
description: Microsoft Outlook is an email service developed by Microsoft, primarily used for managing emails, calendars, tasks, and contacts. It integrates seamlessly with other Microsoft services and offers various features like email sorting, search functionality, and connection to various third-party apps

events.d: Fix folder dropdown pagination/search globals, tighten email validation, remove whereClause, update help text
Create a draft email with subject, body, and recipients (To, CC, BCC); auto-detect HTML or plain-text body and accept comma- or semicolon-separated recipient lists.
Create a calendar event with title, date/time (or all-day), timezone, attendees, location, description, and optional reminders.
Remove an event from your Outlook calendar.
Send an email from your Outlook account, including importance level and optional custom headers.
Apply review fixes to Update Contact: add record selector label, update fields placeholder, conditionally show additional details group, and refactor folder/contact dropdowns to reusable components.
Search contacts by first name, last name, email address, or contact folder.

events.n: When a new contact is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new contact is created in the account or in the selected contact folder.
Get an existing user details.
Retrieve your contact folders, optionally including their child folders.
Retrieve messages from Outlook, optionally filtering by folder, date, unread status, and pagination.
Retrieve events from an Outlook calendar, optionally filtering by calendar, date range, pagination, and selected event fields.
List contacts from Microsoft Outlook. Optionally choose a contact folder and limit the number returned.
Return all mail folders as a single flat list, optionally including hidden folders.
Retrieve mail folder changes since a previous run. Supply the delta token from a prior @odata.deltaLink to return only new or updated folders.

events.n: When a new email is received
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new email is received in the account.
Retrieve emails and their attachments from Outlook using optional filters and pagination.
Forward an Outlook email to new recipients, with optional CC, BCC, and a comment.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new calendar event is created in the connected account.
Moves a selected email into a specified folder. If the user requests to skip, no changes are made and a minimal response is returned.

events.n: Mark Email as Read or Unread
events.d: Mark a specific email as read or unread.
Mark an email as flagged, completed, or cleared, and optionally set start and due dates.
